_comment: STRUCTURAL REFERENCE ONLY — empty skeleton. The real catalog is exported from broadside-analysis.html via the 'Copy JSON' button and dropped at assets/broadside.catalog.json. This .example.json variant exists so Catalog::load_from_path can be smoke-tested against a file with every required top-level key present, without committing interpretive numeric guesswork to the repo. All arrays are intentionally empty. See src/types.rs Catalog for the schema.
